name: fourteen days under FRCP 6 lands on a Friday

steps.text: The trigger day 2026-01-02 is excluded. Counting starts 2026-01-03.
Counted 14 calendar days, including intermediate Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays, through 2026-01-16.
The last day 2026-01-16 is a weekday and not a legal holiday, so it is included.

name: Independence Day observed Friday rolls to Monday

steps.text: The trigger day 2026-07-02 is excluded. Counting starts 2026-07-03.

A legal holiday is a day set aside by FRCP 6(a)(6)(A) or 5 U.S.C. § 6103, including Juneteenth. When that day falls on a Saturday it is observed on Friday, and on a Sunday it is observed on Monday.

name: notice of intention to defend is ten court days

steps.text: The day of the trigger 2026-03-02 is not counted. 10 court days run after it.
A court day is not a Saturday, Sunday, or public holiday under the Public Holidays Act 36 of 1994. A public holiday on a Sunday is also observed on the Monday. The last court day is 2026-03-16.
The days from 16 December to 15 January, both inclusive, are not counted. None of those days fell in this period.
